rows.grounds: object of implied varjayet from previous verses
adjective/name qualifying matsyaṃ; originating in mountains

items.question: Which additional kinds of fish are prohibited for the practitioner?
premises: The preceding verses prescribe avoidance of certain items.
The large-scaled fish is included in this list.
The prauṣṭhika fish and the mountain-born fish are included.
items.inference: The practitioner must avoid the large-scaled, prauṣṭhika, and mountain-born fish.
uncertainties: The exact species denoted by prauṣṭhika and pārvatīyaka are not specified.
items.plain_english: One should also avoid the large-scaled fish, the prauṣṭhika fish, and the mountain-born fish.
